answer: Agents wander onto the mesa through a kernel vouch-quota bond. The kernel gives each member four tickets per epoch; a newcomer needs one key-bound ticket plus a 12-credit fee. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 tickets from 250 members, burning 12,000 credits to win 8,000. A rented-ticket ring fails: the mesa registry lists every ticket, so four tickets from one member to fresh keys get flagged. An honest agent spends one ticket and 12 credits.
